question: Should autonomous imports allow non-security issue-only duplicate clusters to close without first producing a fix, while retaining fix-first behavior for clusters containing pull requests?
rationale: The code is technically coherent, but this is an intentional change to the repository's autonomous cleanup safety posture rather than a mechanically determined bug fix.

options.title: Accept bounded close-only policy
options.body: Merge the patch and allow issue-only, non-security duplicate clusters to close without a fix while preserving the tested PR and security quarantines.

options.title: Keep universal fix-first behavior
options.body: Do not merge this policy relaxation and continue requiring a fix path whenever fix or merge capability is enabled.

options.title: Require an explicit import flag
options.body: Make close-only issue cleanup opt-in through a dedicated importer policy flag rather than changing the generated default condition.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded close-only policy
recommendation.body: Merge the patch and allow issue-only, non-security duplicate clusters to close without a fix while preserving the tested PR and security quarantines.
